implementation: Reuse byte-pinned V9 Transaction.accept_chunk/finalize/native_restore and canonical identity; only explicit TLS manifest/control adapters.

manifest.file_rows: Normalize frozen rows to V9 keys: relative_path,type,sha256,size=size_bytes,allocated=allocated_bytes,dev,inode,nlink,uid,gid,mode=int(mode_octal,8)&0o7777,mtime_ns,ctime_ns; source_path/root/commit retained in original sidecar. Preserve full directory metadata including root dot.
manifest.selector: V9 canonical JSON of normalized files array in explicitly frozen order; source_file_inventory_sha256 is SHA256 of original frozen JSONL; separate directory inventory SHA and full manifest SHA bind metadata.
manifest.source_frozen_commit: Source chooses exact 40-character Git publication containing frozen original file/directory manifests; row source code commits remain independent provenance.
manifest.source_filesystem_identity: Source publishes exact canonical object; target must consume byte-equivalent object, not independently invent a string encoding.
manifest.target_mount_mapping: Replace exact /home/shared prefix with /root/share/mnt164; new group root must be ABSENT, exclusively reserved, never overwrite V9.
manifest.txid: Existing V9 SHA256(canonical JSON of source_filesystem_identity,source_root,selector_sha256,source_frozen_commit,genuine164_destination_root). No second txid spelling or alternate root accepted.

payload.receiver: Only this original 174-new Target; existing unique bridge receiver lock
payload.chunk_ranges: [offset,offset+length), sequential nonoverlapping contiguous ranges per original file; zero length original has no chunk; full ordered range coverage and original full SHA checked at finalization.
payload.bridge_path: Source publishes exact no-symlink path within dedicated TLS V10 payload subtree and exact stat dev/inode/nlink/size/st_blocks plus SHA; original source manifest/path identity independently retained.
payload.compression: No compression initially; original raw-byte chunks use proven V9 range support.

handshake: Source publishes canonical manifest/txid, resource/activity PASS, exact chunk READY and its Git SHA. No payload before exact agreement.

Target validates current source PASS and local gates, bridge identity/full chunk SHA; V9 fsync/close/reopen real164 chunk. Independently native-restore EACH chunk and reopen SHA. Publish DEST_VERIFIED and RESTORE_VERIFIED with proof_scope=CHUNK_RANGE_ONLY and immutable manifest/txid/range/bridge identity; these are not full-file or project restoration claims.

Source independently acknowledges exact target receipt Git SHA and emits SOURCE_KEEP for that chunk. Target verifies exact ACK and exact still-matching owned bridge payload before unlinking ONLY that listed bridge stage, measuring remaining allocated staging and publishing cleanup. Next READY only after closure.

After full group receipt coverage, V9 finalize reconstructs original full files and checks every original full SHA. Then V9 native_restore into a NEW ABSENT native group tree verifies ALL files and directories with numeric UID/GID/mode/mtime, ctime provenance only. Publish independent complete SOURCE->164->RESTORE join, no sample substitution.

native_restore.plan: New private tmpfs native POSIX mount inside target namespace, outside bridge, capped at 24GiB; retains independent per-chunk native proofs and full per-group restored trees. Avoid exhausting shared workspace or Share; no scientific original data is stored only here.
native_restore.filesystem: tmpfs; native chown/chmod/mtime supported; volatile proof workspace only, not durable archive; durable data and recovery tooling remain genuine164.
native_restore.preflight: Mount namespace identity, empty/absent owned mountpoint, current MemAvailable and cgroup available minus full declared restore budget, active Lane reservations and >=64GiB system floor; no scientific restore until source independent PASS. Recheck actual cgroup/memory per batch.
native_restore.retention: No automatic deletion of native restore trees or scientific files; preserve verification copies until disposition. Exact bridge payload cleanup only after both ACKs.
native_restore.required_before_COPY_READY: Target must publish actual native mount/small synthetic metadata probe PASS and confirm projected full scope fits both chunk proof copies plus full original restoration, with headroom. If unsupported or resource PASS unavailable, HOLD; no disk fallback over 48GiB floor.

gates.source_independent_lane_audit: Required post-cutoff before full source hash/staging. Cutoff or target local df alone is not admission; do not stop running sims or alter leases.
gates.per_batch: Fresh source identity/activity/resource PASS plus target genuine164, Share allocated cap, RAM/cgroup; source original identity remains frozen and KEEP. HOLD on stale/disagreeing evidence.
